items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: So the cat that was managing me... Sam Beers!

ctx.x: In the meantime, I got an offer to go out to California with Bing Crosby's brother. And everything was going along great, except the guy didn't want me to leave, you know, because we was doin' business for him. So he stopped it. How he stopped it I'm not too sure yet, but he did.

Yeah, and he stopped it. He also sold my contract to Joe Glaser, unbeknownst to me. See, because what happened with him, the union said his contract was null and void. Right? So to get out of that, he sold it to Joe Glaser. I mean, he had it here in New York, waiting for the moment to swoop down on me, which he did.
